entries.summary: Stakes module that names the affected population with a number ('30 million U.S. households on adjustable-rate mortgages') tested stronger in post-render than abstract stakes have in prior runs.
entries.future_check: In stage 3, the Stakes paragraph for finance stories must contain (a) at least one digit-bearing token AND (b) a noun naming a specific population. Add this as a stage_5 extra check in video-learning/templates/finance.json.

entries.summary: Close anchored on two concrete dates (next FOMC + minutes release) outperformed single-date closes in post-render review.
entries.future_check: For finance stories where both an FOMC decision date AND minutes-release date are knowable, the close should reference both. Add a hint to the close module skeleton.

entries.summary: Stage-5 check C8 ('hook/weak-anchor') flagged a warn even though the hook was strong on a different axis (digit-bearing token in the verb phrase, just not the first 4 words). The check is too narrow.
entries.future_check: Loosen C8 in video-learning/prompts/05-pre-render-critic.md to accept (proper noun in first 4 words) OR (digit-bearing token within first 7 words). Re-test against this story.

entries.summary: First finance story to ship at quality 4. Beats the type's currently-empty example slot on stakes specificity and close anchoring.
